target_customer: Individual heavy RSS readers who pay a small yearly subscription
problem: Feed readers made it hard to read the original site and filter noise. NewsBlur shows the original site, adds training filters and a social layer of shared stories.
business_model: Freemium consumer subscription (free up to 64 sites, paid premium tiers), open source under MIT

founders.name: Samuel Clay
founders.background_notes: Left Tasty Labs in March 2012 to work on NewsBlur full time, per TechCrunch. Started it as a side project about three years earlier. Education not found.

competitors.name: Google Reader
competitors.what: Dominant free web feed reader whose layout NewsBlur was compared to

competitors.name: NetNewsWire
competitors.what: Desktop feed reader compared to in launch coverage

competitors.name: Zite
competitors.what: Machine learning personalized news app contrasted with NewsBlur filters

technical_complexity.rationale: One engineer built a fast feed fetcher, training filters, social features and mobile apps. Scaling the fetching was the hard part, as the 2013 traffic surge showed.

defensibility.rationale: Feeds are open and many readers existed. Trained filters and shared blurblogs create some stickiness, and open source code lowers exclusivity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google announced the Reader shutdown on 2013-03-13. NewsBlur saw about 20 times traffic growth and many new paid users per press coverage, and ran sustainably.

market_need_then: Google Reader was dominant and free, so paid demand was uncertain in 2012. The Reader shutdown in 2013 later created a large wave of users seeking replacements.

branding.name_origin: Not stated by the founder in sources found. A secondhand Hacker News comment says the founder owned other sites with a blur suffix and briefly renamed it Protoread and Protopub before returning to NewsBlur.

identity.logo: Logo files exist in SVG and PNG with light and dark variants per an icon library; design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Founder-run, personal and technical blog voice

branding.community_and_virality: Open source on GitHub, a user forum at forum.newsblur.com, and recommendation in 2013 Google Reader replacement roundups such as Popular Science.

brand_strength.rationale: A recognized name among RSS users after 2013 replacement coverage, but with limited mass awareness.

outcome_analysis: NewsBlur is a one-person open source reader that was funded with tiny capital and ran on subscriptions. The 2013 Google Reader shutdown sent a surge of users and many paid, which made the business sustainable. It remains small, with a team of one on the YC page, and no acquisition or layoffs were reported.
notes: CB Insights lists a 20K seed from Y Combinator on 2012-06-26; single aggregator figure, unverified, so no round recorded. Traffic growth and paid share claims come from 2013 and 2014 secondary coverage. Hacker News name comment is secondhand.
